function.name: speech
function.description: Converts text to a Russian voice message and sends it to the teacher in Telegram. Use only when the teacher explicitly asks for a voice or audio response.

text.description: Text to synthesize and send as a voice message.

instructions.description: Delivery direction for THIS phrase only: tone, pace, emotion, emphasis, pauses (e.g. 'excited and faster', 'slow and solemn', 'whisper', 'emphasize the deadline'). Maximum 150 characters. The base voice persona is applied automatically — never repeat the text itself or the base persona here. Omit when the default delivery already fits.
